commit.message:
Fix some bugs in the PC algorithm (#408)

* Add test for v-structure with marginally independent parents

Covers a collider x → y ← z whose parents are independent roots, so
`skeleton` removes the x–z edge at ℓ=0 in `skeleton_unconditional!`.
Existing cases 1–3 only have colliders with a common ancestor (removed
conditionally at ℓ≥1 in `skeleton_conditional!`), so this structure was
previously untested.

* Store empty separating set on ℓ=0 edge removal

`skeleton_unconditional!` deleted marginally-independent edges without
recording S(i,j), so pairs separated at ℓ=0 had no entry in
`separating_set`. `orient_vstructures` (Rule 0) gates on
`haskey(separating_sets, (X,Z)) && Y ∉ S(X,Z)`, so any v-structure
X → Y ← Z whose parents are independent roots was silently left
unoriented, yielding an incomplete/incorrect CPDAG.

Fixed by passing `separating_set` through `skeleton_unconditional!`
and store S(i,j) = S(j,i) = ∅ when an edge is removed at ℓ=0, matching
line 14 of Algorithm 1 in Kalisch & Bühlmann (2008), which records the
separating set at every level including the empty conditioning set.

* don't comment samples

* Guard skeleton edge tests on neighbor count, not subset count

When deciding whether to delete the edge between nodes i and j, `conditionaltest_and_remove_edge!` gated the test with `length(𝐒) >= 𝓁` (number of candidate conditioning sets). Algorithm 1 line 8 of Kalisch & Bühlmann (2008) requires |adj(C,i)\{j}| ≥ ℓ: node i must have at least 𝓁 neighbors besides j. When i has exactly 𝓁 such neighbors, `length(𝐒) == 1` fails `1 >= 𝓁` for 𝓁 ≥ 2, so the pair is skipped and a spurious edge survives. We now use `!isempty(𝐒)`, a direct transcription of line 8.

Added corresponding test that skips previous elimination steps that would render the test useless.

* Restrict skeleton conditioning sets to size exactly 𝓁

`skeleton_conditional!` built conditioning sets with `powerset(setdiff(aᵢ, j), 𝓁, 𝓁 + 1)`, testing sizes 𝓁 and 𝓁+1 at every level. Algorithm 1 line 10 of Kalisch & Bühlmann (2008) requires |k| = ℓ exactly; the size-(ℓ+1) sets belong to the next level, reached via line 6 (ℓ = ℓ + 1). Testing them a level early can delete an edge with a non-minimal separating set S(i,j), which then flips v-structure orientation in Rule 0, since Rule 0 keys on membership in S(i,j).

Fixed by setting powerset(setdiff(aᵢ, j), 𝓁, 𝓁) (powersets of exactly size 𝓁).  Adds a test that tests this specifically.

* Fix PC orientation rules R2/R3 and harden edge predicates

Rule 3 (`rule3!`) never fired: its candidate filter was always empty and it tried to orient by adding an edge that already existed. Rewrite it to follow Meek R3 as stated in Colombo & Maathuis (2014): orient Xᵢ − Xⱼ into Xᵢ → Xⱼ when two chains Xᵢ − Xₖ → Xⱼ and Xᵢ − Xₗ → Xⱼ exist with Xₖ, Xₗ nonadjacent, orienting by removing the reverse edge.

Rule 2 (`rule2!`) guarded on `adjacent`, so a conflicting pre-existing Xⱼ → Xᵢ edge would be deleted rather than left alone. Tighten to `is_undirected_edge` so R2 only orients genuine undirected edges.

Replace the `is_undirected`/`is_directed` helpers with `is_undirected_edge` and `is_directed_edge`, which check both edge directions and are therefore correct on arbitrary vertex pairs (not only edges known to be present).

* Fix comments

* Fix bug where maxiters wasn't respected

* Fix maxiters_orient handling and correct rule 4 in PC orientation

- Add tests: compare against CausalInference.jl for a collider with common effects, and a direct rule3! orientation test (difficult to catch with end-to-end test).

Rule 4 fixes in prep for coming pre-knowledge implementation:
- Rewrite `rule4!` to Meek (1995): orient Xᵢ → Xⱼ from an undirected Xᵢ − Xₖ plus a directed chain Xₖ → Xₗ → Xⱼ with Xᵢ,Xₗ adjacent and Xₖ,Xⱼ nonadjacent. Kalisch & Bühlmann (2008) misstate the nonadjacent pair (k,l) are adjacent by construction); this is now documented in the source.
- Keep R4 disabled: R1-R3 already yield the complete CPDAG when there is no background knowledge, so R4 never fires on PC output.

* Use bibtex for references

* Up version

* Remove duplicate refs

* remove old version line

* Pin StateSpaceSets.jl to fix SSS constructor

Ref https://github.com/JuliaDynamics/StateSpaceSets.jl/commit/e85d0bab8d44712a3ff17f0a4b006220fef55277

* Pin StateSpaceSets.jl to fix SSS constructor

Ref https://github.com/JuliaDynamics/StateSpaceSets.jl/commit/e85d0bab8d44712a3ff17f0a4b006220fef55277

* Update LTS julia version

* Fix spacing

* order

* Up ComplexityMeasures version to 3.10

In this version, `TransferOperator <: ProbabilitiesEstimator`, not `TransferOperator <: OutcomeSpace`.

* Up minor version

Create an entirely new version that allows ComplexityMeasures v3.10

* Throw error when using `ProbabilitiesEstimator` with `CodifyVariables`

Inform user on what to do to retrieve the old behaviour for `TransferOperator`.

* Remove duplicate ref causing doc build to fail

* Change example using `TransferOperator` to `ValueBinning`

* remove duplicate doc entries causing doc build error

* Add missing label to docs

* Up version of ComplexityMeasures in docs

* fix refs

* remove duplicate version

* This is a bug fix, so up patch version
